payload.title: CUTLASS 3.x Architecture
payload.summary: CUTLASS 3.x is a major architectural overhaul of CUTLASS 2.x with the core goal of introducing CuTe as a unified Layout algebra system, decoupling the GEMM hierarchy from hardware-coupled designs into algorithm-driven abstraction layers. This document covers the design philosophy, four-level hierarchy, Builder pattern, scheduling strategy system, code organization, and feature matrix of 3.x.
